goal: `scripts/measure-steps.py` counts parallel tool calls per model response (one `message.id`), not per transcript line, and prints how many single-call read responses could have shared a response with the one before.
The role text asks a session to name what it will read up front and fetch it in one response.

success_criteria.criterion: Over the opus-5.5 window, measure-steps reports multi-call responses per message id (about 13 % of tool responses, where the old per-line count gives 0) and a foldable-read row with a request count and a USD share.
success_criteria.check: `python3 scripts/measure-steps.py --since 2026-09-26 --until 2026-10-13` prints both rows; the multi-call share is above 5 %.

success_criteria.criterion: `canon/roles/_common.md` carries the sharpened line in place of the old one.
success_criteria.check: `grep -n 'Before you read' canon/roles/_common.md` finds it; `grep -n 'Independent Bash commands in one call' canon/roles/_common.md` finds nothing.

steps.title: Count parallel calls per response, show the foldable reads, sharpen the role line
steps.done_when: `python3 scripts/measure-steps.py --since 2026-09-26 --until 2026-10-13` prints a multi-call share above 5 % and a foldable-read row, `_common.md` carries the new line in place of the old, and `mc gate` is green.
